## Design

### 2026-10-08 – Worked on drawing out the outline, design, and what the software will look like for my starbie. The Starbie is going to be like a mini game console with a dirt bike driving game instead of a regular A

**1.5h**

Worked on drawing out the outline, design, and what the software will look like for my starbie. The Starbie is going to be like a mini game console with a dirt bike driving game instead of a regular Animal Tamagochi Starbie.

### 2026-10-08 – Redesigned and remade the 3D model of the front, back, and middle plates of the starbie (mini motocross sim). Added a middle "sandwich" piece so it can be designed and made easier.

**4.5h**

Redesigned and remade the 3D model of the front, back, and middle plates of the starbie (mini motocross sim). Added a middle "sandwich" piece so it can be designed and made easier.
